name: Maya
source:
Maya is an asexual princess battling with her feelings about the marriage she is about to enter int. About how she can be a wife and mother while not wanting sex, but feeling as though she can not discuss this with her betrothed. Little does she know, he has his own secrets.

[Edited from [url=https://whitefort.itch.io/mayavn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛雅是一位无性恋公主，即将缔结婚姻，心中却十分纠结。不想发生性关系，该怎样做一个妻子、一个母亲？她觉得自己没办法和未婚夫谈这些事。她不知道的是，他也有自己的秘密。
